task:

Money answers are integers in minor currency units (100 cents/pence = 1 major unit). Cite at least one supporting page source_id per answer; a payment-evidence unknown may cite the order page. For string questions use the listed labels. Provide a short review_note about evidence or process limits, without verbatim quotations.
